# Mikael Alemu Gorsky

> Educator and researcher, and the author of two programs: Agentic Software Engineering, on building software with AI agents, and Building AI-Native Agentic Systems, on building software that thinks. Teaches at the Holon Institute of Technology (HIT) near Tel Aviv, Israel, where Agentic Software Engineering runs as a credit-bearing course. Nine published works, 76 citations. A 350-page textbook under contract with a major academic publisher.

## Site structure

- [Homepage](https://mgorsky.net/): Teaching and programs, research, and pro bono
- [Bio](https://mgorsky.net/bio): Short biography and professional links
- [Agentic Software Engineering](https://mgorsky.net/ase26): A conceptual framework, curriculum, and teaching foundation for agentic software engineering — 19 modules across four parts (the discipline, the environment, the engineering, the market). Includes the conceptual model, glossary, learning outcomes, assessment design, and tooling reference. Version 1.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20468021.
- [Agentic Coding](https://mgorsky.net/teaching/agentic-coding): 40-hour semester course on AI-assisted development
- [Change Management](https://mgorsky.net/teaching/change-management): 4-hour executive seminar on AI transformation
- [AI for Seniors](https://mgorsky.net/probono/ai-for-seniors): Free workshop helping older adults adopt AI tools
- [Publications](https://mgorsky.net/research/academic): Nine works, 76 citations. Research on artificial intelligence in education, with Ilya Levin and Alexei Semenov
- [The AI Pravda](https://mgorsky.net/theaipravda): Newsletter with critical analysis of artificial intelligence and its effect on work and society (5,500+ subscribers)
- [AI Chronicles](https://mgorsky.net/aichronicles): Daily digest, rolodex, and book project
